blocks.text:
**In design. There is nothing to install yet.**

Folio Keys is a keyboard for the rest of Folio: a separate app, because Android requires a keyboard to be its own input method, listed here so it shows up where Folio's other pieces do.

It reads the window rather than the phone model. On a book fold it splits around the crease so no key sits on the hinge; unfolded it splits with the middle holding what thumbs cannot reach; on a short window it gets out of the way. It has no internet permission, which is the one promise the system can enforce on your behalf.

The pictures below are from Folio's mockup lab, not from a shipping app.

items: Splits around the crease of a book fold
Split, one-handed and floating, chosen by the window
Key gestures: swipe a key to copy, paste, cut or undo
An action shelf that stays pinned instead of hiding
Clipboard history with pinned clips and snippets
A profile per app: theme, shelf, layout, gestures, learning
Typing insights: the words you fix most and the keys you miss
Swearing is never corrected into another word
Folio's look or the flat Android one
No internet permission, no account, nothing leaves the phone
